name: ceremony
note: Pure verbs are lockedlambda-ready; effectful orchestration (marked kind:effect) seals/encrypts and uses randomness — it must resolve at the effect site when lifted into plastron.

metadata.name: ceremony.partition
metadata.description: (records) — split consolidated records into { active, archived } by the archived flag.

metadata.name: ceremony.sliceForResources
metadata.description: (records, readable) — records tagged to at least one readable resource; a user's RBAC slice.

metadata.name: ceremony.resourcesIn
metadata.description: (records) — the sorted set of distinct resources referenced by a record set.

metadata.name: ceremony.serialize
metadata.description: (records) — deterministic canonical bytes of a record set (sorted), reproducible and hashable.

metadata.name: ceremony.lock
metadata.description: (input) — close-out lock: refuses without archive+backup keys or if missing any resource DEK; emits active vault (k-of-n) + archive + backup.

metadata.name: ceremony.openArchive
metadata.description: (archiveSealed, archivist) — open the archive dump; only the archival private key works.

metadata.name: ceremony.distribute
metadata.description: (records, recipients) — per-recipient RBAC slice sealed to each recipient's key.

metadata.name: ceremony.openSlice
metadata.description: (sealed, recipient) — a recipient opens their distributed slice with their key.
